Ellevest is a financial services brand focused on women's wealth management and financial guidance, offering personalized investment and planning services.
properties.description: Ellevest is a women-founded and led financial services firm dedicated to closing the gender wealth gap through personalized wealth management and financial planning. As an SEC-registered fiduciary, the firm prioritizes its clients' best interests by offering strategic portfolio management that accounts for women's unique financial realities. It provides services ranging from financial planning to private wealth management, with an emphasis on values-aligned investing and tax optimization. By addressing the historical shortcomings of the traditional, male-dominated financial industry, the brand empowers women to reach their financial goals and build long-term wealth.

properties.short_description: World Nomads is a global travel, lifestyle, and insurance brand offering simple, flexible travel insurance and travel inspiration to adventurous travelers.
properties.description: Established in 2002, this brand provides flexible travel insurance and vital safety information tailored for the needs of independent and adventurous travelers worldwide. Beyond insurance, it fosters a global community by offering travel guides, educational storytelling scholarships, and opportunities for social impact through micro-donations. Its positioning as a bridge between safety and discovery appeals to those who prioritize authentic exploration and responsible tourism. The brand remains a key resource for those seeking to navigate international travel with confidence and curiosity.

properties.short_description: Venmo is an American mobile payment service that allows users to send and receive money, split bills, and share payments with friends.
properties.description: A pioneering mobile payment service that has transformed how individuals manage social financial interactions. Originally designed for simple peer-to-peer transfers, the brand has evolved into a comprehensive digital wallet that supports retail payments, credit options, and cryptocurrency trading. It serves a broad audience of tech-savvy individuals and businesses, positioning itself as the standard for seamless, integrated financial management. By blending social functionality with robust transaction tools, it remains an essential component of the modern digital-first economy.

properties.short_description: Klarna is a Swedish fintech brand offering flexible online payment solutions including pay later, installment plans, and a Visa card accepted worldwide.
properties.description: Klarna is a prominent Swedish fintech company that has redefined the online shopping experience by integrating flexible payment solutions directly into the checkout process. Founded in 2005, the firm provides consumers with interest-free installment plans, pay-later options, and a secure virtual card for global shopping. By blending consumer-facing financial tools with robust merchant payment processing, the brand acts as a bridge between shoppers and retailers. It currently operates in numerous countries, maintaining a strong commitment to digital-first innovation and secure, transparent transactions.

properties.short_description: Acorns is a financial technology brand offering automated saving, investing, and spending tools through expert-built diversified portfolios and Round-Ups®.
properties.description: A financial technology firm that simplifies wealth creation by automating savings and investing through rounding up daily transactions. Since its founding, the company has focused on making investment tools accessible to everyone, regardless of their starting capital. It offers various subscription plans that bundle investing, retirement, and family banking features into a single user-friendly mobile application. The brand aims to empower individuals to build long-term financial security through simple, repeatable, and automated financial habits.

properties.short_description: Square is a financial services and business management platform powering over 4 million businesses globally with payment processing, point of sale hardware, and business software solutions.
properties.description: An integrated platform that provides businesses with the necessary tools to process payments, manage inventory, schedule appointments, and run operations efficiently. Founded to democratize access to financial technology, it supports millions of merchants ranging from independent pop-ups to established retail and food service chains. Its ecosystem combines hardware, software, and financial services to offer a unified business management experience. By simplifying the complexities of commerce, the brand helps entrepreneurs focus on growth and customer engagement.

properties.short_description: Twine is an open-source tool for creating interactive, nonlinear stories without coding.
properties.description: Twine is an automated intelligence platform that connects to B2B business workflows to extract, analyze, and deliver actionable insights from customer conversations. By integrating with existing call tools and collaboration software, it eliminates manual note-taking and surfaces critical feedback, competitive intelligence, and revenue-related patterns. The tool is designed to empower product, sales, and customer success teams to make faster, data-driven decisions that align with real-time customer demand. Its primary value proposition is transforming scattered qualitative data into quantitative evidence to reduce churn and improve product outcomes.

properties.short_description: Toggle is an insurance brand offering customizable renters and auto insurance with coverage that follows you wherever you go.
properties.description: Launched as a tech-focused subsidiary of Farmers Insurance, this brand simplifies the insurance process through a fully digital, customizable interface. It specifically targets renters and car owners who seek flexible policies that fit their unique lifestyle needs rather than traditional, one-size-fits-all bundles. By focusing on mobile accessibility, the brand aims to make insurance approachable for younger generations and tech-savvy consumers. Its market positioning emphasizes simplicity and empowerment, allowing users to select only the coverage they need.

properties.short_description: Capital One is a diversified bank offering credit cards, checking, savings, auto loans, business and commercial banking services, and digital financial tools.
properties.description: Capital One is a diversified financial services company providing a broad range of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients. Founded on the principle of leveraging data and technology to offer customized financial solutions, the firm has grown into one of the largest banking institutions in the United States. Its offerings span credit cards, consumer banking, and commercial banking, all integrated through a robust digital infrastructure. The organization is widely recognized for its consumer-centric approach to banking, emphasizing accessibility and credit-building tools for its users.

properties.short_description: Ally is a leading digital financial services company offering banking, investing, and auto finance products, including high-yield savings and no overdraft fees.
properties.description: Ally is a prominent digital financial services company that operates without traditional branch locations to provide a streamlined, technology-driven banking experience. Originally a division of General Motors, it has evolved into an independent leader in digital banking, investment advisory, and auto financing. The brand focuses on empowering customers through transparency, high-yield savings options, and user-friendly digital tools for managing personal wealth. It serves a wide range of consumers, emphasizing financial education and accessibility while maintaining a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility and a culture of belonging.

properties.short_description: Wealthfront is a financial services brand offering automated investment portfolios, high-yield cash accounts, and tax-efficient strategies through a robo-advisor platform.
properties.description: Wealthfront is an automated investment platform that leverages advanced technology to provide low-cost, tax-efficient, and diversified portfolios for individual investors. Since its inception, the company has focused on removing barriers to wealth management by automating core processes like portfolio rebalancing and tax-loss harvesting. It serves a broad demographic of retail investors, including tech-savvy professionals and young families, through a streamlined, mobile-first experience. As a leader in the robo-advisory category, the firm prioritizes long-term, index-based growth strategies over speculative trading.

properties.short_description: SoFi is a financial technology company offering banking, personal loans, investing, credit cards, and mortgage services.
properties.description: An American financial services company that offers a comprehensive, mobile-integrated platform for banking, borrowing, and investing. Founded in 2011, the company has evolved from a student loan refinancing specialist into a broad neobank. It serves a demographic of digital-native professionals seeking to consolidate their financial activities into a single, efficient application. The brand competes by offering a streamlined user experience and integrated financial products, maintaining a challenger status within the traditional retail banking landscape.

properties.short_description: Aspiration is a financial technology company offering climate-friendly banking services, sustainable investment funds, and green checking accounts.
properties.description: A financial services firm focused on providing banking and investment options that align with personal sustainability goals. The platform distinguishes itself by explicitly ensuring that customer deposits do not fund fossil fuel projects. Through a digital-native model, it serves eco-conscious consumers looking to integrate their financial activities with their environmental ethics. The brand serves as a bridge between traditional banking utility and active climate advocacy.

properties.short_description: American Express is a global financial services brand known for credit cards, rewards, travel, and business solutions.
properties.description: An iconic financial services corporation known for its credit and charge card products, particularly those offering premium travel benefits and rewards. Established in 1850, it has evolved from a freight-forwarding company into a global leader in the payment industry, catering primarily to affluent individuals and businesses. The brand differentiates itself through high-touch customer support, extensive airport lounge access, and exclusive partnership programs. It maintains a strong heritage and prestige, positioning itself as a vital tool for those who prioritize security, lifestyle access, and efficient financial management.

properties.short_description: Simple is a brand offering a website at simple.com, but specific product or service details are not clearly identified.
properties.description: Originally established in 2009, this pioneering neobank focused on improving personal financial management by integrating traditional banking services with intuitive budgeting software. The brand served as a significant player in the fintech space, catering to tech-savvy individuals who preferred digital-first financial experiences. Following its acquisition by a major global bank, its operations were eventually integrated into broader digital banking initiatives.

properties.short_description: Guayakí is an organic beverage company specializing in yerba mate products, offering a variety of brewed yerba mate blends in still and sparkling formats.
properties.description: Guayakí is a pioneer in the yerba mate industry, committed to regenerative agriculture and sustainable business practices. The brand offers a wide range of organic brewed yerba mate products in both still and sparkling formats, designed to provide a natural, clean energy boost. Their mission focuses on empowering indigenous communities and protecting biodiversity in South American rainforests. By combining traditional cultural roots with modern consumer needs, they appeal to environmentally conscious individuals seeking an alternative to conventional energy drinks and coffee.

properties.short_description: LaCroix Sparkling Water is an American brand of zero-calorie, zero-sweetener flavored sparkling water known for its variety of natural fruit flavors.
properties.description: LaCroix is a prominent American sparkling water brand celebrated for its variety of natural, essence-flavored options that contain no calories, sweeteners, or artificial additives. Established in the early 1980s, the brand gained massive popularity for its vibrant, distinctive packaging and health-conscious profile. It has since become a cult favorite, appealing to a wide range of consumers looking for a refreshing, guilt-free alternative to sugary sodas. By focusing on simple, clean ingredients, the brand has firmly positioned itself as a lifestyle staple for modern, wellness-oriented households.

properties.short_description: Myteadrop is a woman and minority owned company that produces organic whole leaf tea shaped into dissolvable drops, offering bagless, cafe-quality tea brewed at home.
properties.description: An innovative, woman and minority-owned company that has redefined the tea-drinking experience by creating whole leaf tea drops that dissolve in hot water. By eliminating the need for tea bags, the brand offers a sustainable and convenient solution for cafe-quality tea at home. Their product range focuses on high-quality, organic ingredients, catering to consumers who prioritize both efficiency and premium flavor. The brand has built a dedicated community by positioning itself as the go-to provider for 'bagless' tea moments.

properties.short_description: Boxed Water Is Better offers 100% pure water in 92% plant-based, recyclable paper cartons as a sustainable alternative to plastic bottles and cans.
properties.description: Boxed Water Is Better provides a sustainable hydration alternative by packaging pure water in 92% plant-based, 100% recyclable paper cartons. Founded on the mission to reduce plastic waste, the company targets environmentally conscious consumers looking for functional, lower-impact choices. Through consistent tree-planting initiatives and a commitment to material innovation, the brand positions itself as a challenger in the premium bottled water category.

properties.short_description: Pressed Juicery is a leading brand offering cold-pressed juices, smoothies, cleanses, and plant-based wellness products focused on convenient, healthy living.
properties.description: Pressed Juicery is a leading wellness brand dedicated to making healthy, plant-based nutrition accessible through its wide range of cold-pressed juices, smoothies, and cleanses. Founded with the philosophy of 'powered by nature,' the company offers functional products designed to support hydration, immunity, and overall well-being. With a combination of brick-and-mortar storefronts, local delivery, and nationwide shipping, it serves a broad audience of health-conscious individuals. The brand is known for its commitment to high-quality ingredients and a clean, modern aesthetic that defines its market-leading position in the functional beverage category.

properties.short_description: Curious Elixirs is a brand of award-winning booze-free craft cocktails made with organic ingredients and adaptogens to help you unwind.
properties.description: Curious Elixirs produces award-winning, non-alcoholic craft cocktails infused with adaptogens to help consumers unwind. Founded in 2015, the brand focuses on layered, complex flavor profiles inspired by classic cocktails, using organic ingredients to provide a premium social experience without alcohol. It targets health-conscious adults who value mindfulness and wellness, operating primarily through a direct-to-consumer subscription model.

properties.short_description: blk. is a brand of alkaline bottled water infused with fulvic and humic acids, trace minerals, and electrolytes for hydration and wellness.
properties.description: Blk. Water is a pioneer in the functional beverage space, known for its unique, dark-colored alkaline water infused with fulvic and humic acids. Founded in 2011, the brand integrates essential trace minerals and electrolytes to provide a premium hydration experience. With a strong emphasis on wellness and positive values like balance and kindness, it appeals to health-conscious consumers who prioritize both functional performance and distinct, modern aesthetics in their everyday life.

properties.short_description: Jarritos is a Mexican brand of natural fruit-flavored carbonated soft drinks known for traditional Mexican flavors like tamarind, lime, and guava.
properties.description: Jarritos is an iconic Mexican soft drink brand founded in 1950 by Don Francisco Hill, known for its commitment to authentic, natural fruit flavors. Over the past seven decades, it has evolved from a local favorite into a global symbol of Mexican culture, recognizable by its signature glass bottle and vibrant colors. The brand bridges tradition and modernity through partnerships across fashion and personal care, maintaining a strong, devoted following. Today, Jarritos remains a staple pairing for tacos and street food, available in over 45 countries worldwide.

properties.short_description: STōK Cold Brew is a brand of cold brew coffee known for its bold, low and slow brewed coffee products designed to energize and inspire.
properties.description: STōK Cold Brew is a prominent coffee brand known for its commitment to a slow, methodical brewing process that produces a smooth, low-acid, and high-caffeine coffee. Designed for busy consumers who require convenient energy without compromising on flavor, the brand has established itself as a staple in the refrigerated coffee category. It leverages bold branding and active lifestyle partnerships, such as its role with Wrexham AFC, to reach a broad audience of active, performance-oriented coffee drinkers. STōK emphasizes consistency and a high-quality, ready-to-drink experience that integrates seamlessly into daily routines.

properties.short_description: Four Sigmatic is a brand offering organic superfoods and functional mushroom products, including mushroom coffee blends for focus and immune support.
properties.description: Founded by a 13th-generation farmer, this brand has established itself as a leader in the functional mushroom space by combining traditional wisdom with modern scientific rigor. It offers a premium line of mushroom-infused coffee and superfoods designed to provide focus, energy, and digestive support without the typical crash associated with standard caffeine. By using only concentrated fruiting body extracts and organic ingredients, the brand appeals to health-conscious consumers and high-performers seeking transparent, effective wellness solutions. Its products are widely available through direct-to-consumer channels and major health-focused retailers, maintaining a strong cult following through its consistent quality and research-driven approach.

properties.short_description: Tazo is a tea brand offering bold blends including tea bags, K-Cup® pods, and lattes, known for innovative tea-infused recipes.
properties.description: A prominent tea and herbal tea manufacturer founded in 1994, recognized for its bold, inventive blends and focus on high-quality ingredients. The brand offers a wide range of formats including tea bags, concentrates, K-Cup pods, and latte powders, catering to consumers who seek flavorful and modern tea experiences. With a market presence across the United States and Canada, the entity positions itself as an accessible but premium choice for everyday rituals. It continuously evolves its portfolio to incorporate wellness-driven ingredients and creative flavor combinations to maintain strong cultural relevance.

properties.short_description: Death Wish Coffee Co. is a brand known for its organic, fair trade, and high-caffeine dark roast coffee products, including premium cold brew lattes.
properties.description: Death Wish Coffee Co. is a prominent provider of high-caffeine, organic, and fair-trade coffee products known for its bold flavor and high-impact energy. Founded in 2012, the brand has cultivated a cult following through its rebellious, dark-themed identity and its reputation for delivering exceptionally strong coffee. It offers a range of whole bean, ground coffee, and convenient ready-to-drink options like cold brew lattes. The brand appeals to high-performance, coffee-loving consumers who seek a reliable, high-energy boost without compromising on taste or ethical sourcing.

properties.short_description: Kencko offers organic, instant fruit and vegetable smoothie mixes and snacks made from real produce, focusing on healthy, natural nutrition.
properties.description: Kencko is a health-driven brand that solves the modern dietary challenge of consuming sufficient fruits and vegetables by offering shelf-stable, freeze-dried smoothie mixes. Founded on the principle of accessibility and inspired by Japanese wellness culture, the brand creates nutrient-dense, plant-based products without artificial additives. By utilizing slow-drying technology, it addresses food waste and provides a convenient solution for busy consumers. As a B Corp, the company emphasizes sustainability throughout its operations, from compostable packaging to carbon-offsetting shipping methods.

properties.short_description: Flow Alkaline Spring Water is 100% naturally alkaline water sourced from artesian springs, known for its smooth, clean taste and eco-friendly packaging.
properties.description: Flow Alkaline Spring Water provides naturally alkaline water sourced from protected artesian springs. The brand is distinguished by its pH level of 8.1 and its commitment to using plant-based, eco-friendly cartons to minimize environmental impact. Targeting health-conscious consumers, it bridges the gap between premium hydration and sustainable, planet-positive product design.

properties.short_description: Brew Dr. is a B-Corp certified brand offering organic, probiotic kombucha in various natural flavors as a healthy, tasty tea alternative.
properties.description: Brew Dr. is a B-Corp certified producer of premium, organic, and probiotic-rich kombucha. Founded in 2008 in Portland, the brand focuses on crafting fizzy, flavorful tea alternatives that support gut health without artificial additives. By maintaining a deep commitment to transparency and environmental stewardship, the brand has become a staple for health-conscious consumers seeking functional beverages that align with their sustainable values.

properties.short_description: Urban Outfitters is a lifestyle retailer offering clothing, homeware, and accessories inspired by creativity and cultural trends.
properties.description: Established in 1970, this lifestyle retailer serves a youthful audience with a carefully curated collection of clothing, accessories, and home goods. The brand is known for its eclectic aesthetic that draws from vintage trends, indie music culture, and modern bohemian style. Operating primarily as a brick-and-mortar and e-commerce entity, it functions as a destination for creative young adults looking for self-expression through fashion and living space design. It remains a fixture in urban and university areas, maintaining a balance between accessible, trendy apparel and lifestyle products.

properties.short_description: UNIF is a fashion brand known for platform boots, baby tees, dresses, denim, and shoes, emphasizing small-batch production and quick shipping.
properties.description: UNIF is a Los Angeles-based fashion brand that has cultivated a strong following through its distinct, subculture-inspired aesthetic. Known for its signature platform boots, graphic tees, and curated collections, the brand emphasizes individuality and rejects mass production. It operates primarily as a direct-to-consumer label, targeting fashion-conscious youth who value bold, nostalgic style. The brand's commitment to small-batch production reinforces its appeal as a niche, trend-setting entity in the contemporary fashion landscape.

properties.short_description: Buffalo Exchange is a US-based retail brand specializing in buying, selling, and trading new and recycled fashion through around 40 thrift store locations.
properties.description: Established in 1974, this pioneer in the resale industry operates over 40 brick-and-mortar stores across the United States. The brand offers a unique buy-sell-trade business model, allowing customers to receive cash or store trade on-the-spot for their gently used clothing and accessories. Focused on sustainability, the company promotes the circular economy by providing an accessible and fun environment for curating a personal wardrobe. The business remains committed to its founding tenets of respect, fairness, and community-building.

properties.short_description: Polaroid is a brand known for instant photography products, including instant cameras and film, continuing the legacy of the original Polaroid Corporation.
properties.description: A historic leader in the field of instant photography, recognized globally for its pioneering development of self-developing film and consumer-facing analog hardware. The brand operates at the intersection of technology and art, prioritizing the creation of tangible, physical memories over digital-first alternatives. With a legacy dating back to the late 1930s, it maintains strong market relevance among creative demographics by blending iconic industrial design with modern, user-friendly features. It serves a diverse community of artists, hobbyists, and memory-seekers who value the spontaneous and imperfect nature of analog images.

properties.short_description: Free People is a women's clothing brand specializing in bohemian fashion, offering trendy and vintage-inspired apparel and accessories.
properties.description: Established in 1984, the brand serves as a prominent retail destination for bohemian-inspired fashion and lifestyle products. It caters to a creative, free-spirited audience through an eclectic collection of apparel, footwear, and accessories that prioritize romance and individuality. As part of a larger retail corporation, the company maintains a strong market position by blending a vintage-inspired aesthetic with modern, relaxed silhouettes. The brand continues to cultivate a dedicated community through its distinct visual identity and focus on the creative lifestyle.

properties.short_description: Lazy Oaf is an independent streetwear brand known for its unique, playful, and youth nostalgia-inspired men's and women's clothing.
properties.description: Established in London in 2001, this independent streetwear brand has carved out a unique space in the fashion world through its signature playful and graphic-heavy aesthetic. Focusing on youth nostalgia and individuality, the brand produces a range of apparel and accessories that prioritize creativity over industry trends. With a design language characterized by bold prints and quirky patterns, it appeals to a global community of consumers who view fashion as a tool for self-expression. By maintaining its independent roots and operational agility, the label continues to foster a cult following centered on fun, authenticity, and artistic collaboration.

properties.short_description: Independent sunglass brand offering funky, bioacetate sunglasses designed and tested beachside in Los Angeles, known for premium quality and affordable prices.
properties.description: Established in Los Angeles, this independent eyewear brand creates funky, high-quality sunglasses designed by a close-knit group of surfers, skaters, and artists. By utilizing bioacetate and maintaining a focus on carbon neutrality, the brand prioritizes environmental impact alongside accessible pricing. Their design process is rooted in coastal lifestyle, with every frame tested beachside to ensure durability and style. They serve as a go-to for trend-conscious individuals who value authenticity, creativity, and conscious consumption.

properties.short_description: Black Lives Matter is a global movement advocating for racial justice and the economic empowerment of Black communities.
properties.description: An international human rights movement that began in the United States, campaigning against violence and systemic racism toward Black people. Through a decentralized network, it organizes protests, advocates for policy change, and fosters community empowerment. The entity functions as a vital voice in modern civil rights discourse, focusing on structural reform and social justice. It is characterized by its grassroots approach, mobilizing collective action to address deeply rooted social inequities.

properties.short_description: Glossier is a beauty brand offering skincare, makeup, and fragrances inspired by real life, emphasizing a 'Skin First. Makeup Second™' philosophy.
properties.description: A digital-first beauty and skincare brand founded in 2014 that focuses on high-quality, uncomplicated products designed for everyday use. With a 'skin first' philosophy, the company emphasizes enhancing natural features rather than covering them up. The brand has cultivated a massive community through social media, engaging customers in the product development process. It operates primarily through an e-commerce model, supplemented by strategic retail partnerships and physical showrooms.

properties.short_description: BlackMilk Clothing is a Brisbane-based fashion label known for unique, curve-hugging dresses and pop culture-inspired apparel.
properties.description: Originally founded in a kitchen in Brisbane, this brand has evolved from a small blogging project into a global fashion phenomenon known for its unique stretch-fabric designs. The brand operates as a creative hub for pop-culture enthusiasts, offering apparel that feels more like a costume department than a standard clothing line. By fostering a deep connection with its digital community, it empowers customers to tell their own stories through bold, high-quality, and often playful garment collections. It remains a fixture for those who value self-expression and want to stand out with striking prints and unconventional fashion choices.

properties.short_description: Good Dye Young is a vegan and cruelty-free hair care brand offering vibrant, semi-permanent hair color products formulated to keep hair healthy and shiny.
properties.description: Founded by musician Hayley Williams and stylist Brian O'Connor, this brand offers professional-grade, vibrant semi-permanent hair color formulated with hair-healthy ingredients. It distinguishes itself through a strong commitment to vegan and cruelty-free practices, aiming to provide a high-performance alternative to traditional chemical hair dyes. The brand fosters a sense of community by encouraging self-expression and creative experimentation among its diverse audience. Its market positioning combines salon-quality results with accessible at-home convenience, appealing to creative individuals who view their appearance as a form of personal art.

properties.short_description: Aerie is a women's clothing brand specializing in intimates, activewear, swimwear, and casual apparel promoting body positivity and real beauty.
properties.description: Aerie is a prominent intimate apparel and lifestyle brand that emphasizes body positivity and comfort. Originally launched as a sub-brand of American Eagle Outfitters, it has gained widespread recognition for its commitment to unretouched photography and inclusive marketing. The brand offers a diverse range of bras, underwear, activewear, and loungewear designed for everyday wear. It primarily targets younger consumers by focusing on confidence, self-acceptance, and real beauty.

properties.short_description: American Apparel is a clothing manufacturer, distributor, and retailer known for ethically made, sweatshop-free apparel including blank t-shirts and timeless basics.
properties.description: Originally established in 1989, this brand is a recognized name in the fashion industry for its focus on ethically manufactured, high-quality staples. It specializes in versatile basics like t-shirts, hoodies, and leggings that cater to a broad audience. By prioritizing transparent production and sweatshop-free conditions, the brand has carved a niche for itself as a responsible choice for everyday apparel. Its market positioning bridges the gap between mass-market affordability and social consciousness, maintaining a minimalist aesthetic that remains relevant across multiple generations.

properties.short_description: ModCloth is an online retailer specializing in vintage-inspired women's fashion and inclusive sizing, offering unique clothing and accessories.
properties.description: ModCloth is an online retailer dedicated to women's clothing, recognized for its curated selection of vintage-inspired apparel and commitment to size inclusivity. Founded in 2002, the brand emphasizes 'dopamine dressing' by offering playful, colorful, and unique designs that encourage personal expression. With a strong presence in the US, it serves a community of shoppers who value retro aesthetics and body positivity. The brand's product range spans dresses, tops, bottoms, and accessories, maintaining a accessible mid-market price point while fostering a loyal, creative customer base.

properties.short_description: Pop & Suki is a fashion brand offering apparel and accessories, co-founded by best friends including Suki Waterhouse.
properties.description: Founded by best friends, this accessories brand centers on the intersection of personal style, community, and friendship. It offers a variety of products, including handbags, jewelry, and leather goods, that are designed to be both stylish and customizable. Known for its playful, minimalist aesthetic and distinct color palette, the brand has gained a cult following among trend-focused consumers who prioritize self-expression. It operates primarily through a direct-to-consumer model, maintaining a strong digital presence that celebrates the bond between friends.

properties.short_description: Nasty Gal is an American fast-fashion retailer specializing in women's clothing, footwear, and accessories with a bold, rebellious style.
properties.description: An American digital-first retailer that specializes in providing trend-driven clothing and accessories to a young, fashion-conscious audience. Founded in 2006, the brand has grown from a boutique operation into a global player within the fast-fashion space, known for its bold aesthetic and rapid release cycle. It primarily serves women who look to social media and current youth culture for stylistic inspiration. As part of the Boohoo Group, it maintains a significant presence as a competitive, price-sensitive fashion destination.

properties.short_description: Co–Star is a hyper-personalized astrology app providing real-time horoscopes and natal charts using NASA data and social features.
properties.description: Co–Star is a technology company that modernizes traditional astrology by combining complex planetary data with hyper-personalized, digital-first content. Launched in 2017, the application provides users with detailed natal charts, daily horoscopes, and compatibility insights intended for self-reflection and social connection. It has carved out a unique position as a leading digital platform for astrological guidance, known for its distinct, minimalist design and candid tone of voice. The service appeals to a broad, tech-savvy audience seeking meaningful frameworks to interpret their relationships and personal lives.

properties.short_description: Society6 is an online marketplace offering artist-designed wall art, home decor, tech accessories, and lifestyle products.
properties.description: An online platform that bridges the gap between independent creators and consumers looking to curate unique spaces. By offering an extensive range of goods printed with original artwork, the brand empowers users to integrate professional-grade design into their daily lives. It functions as a global marketplace that highlights diverse artistic perspectives while maintaining an accessible price point. Through its print-on-demand model, it supports a wide community of artists while providing customers with customizable home decor and lifestyle accessories.

properties.short_description: Madewell is a clothing brand known for women's and men's jeans, clothing, shoes, and bags, emphasizing quality denim and casual style.
properties.description: Established in 2006, this brand has become a staple for those seeking high-quality denim and effortless, everyday apparel. It bridges the gap between mass-market affordability and luxury durability, offering a curated selection of clothing, footwear, and leather accessories. The brand is deeply committed to sustainability and ethical production practices, often emphasizing community and social responsibility. With a focus on versatility, the collections are designed to provide a timeless base for a modern, active lifestyle.

properties.short_description: Wildfox is a women's fashion brand known for its clothing collections and accessories featuring vintage-inspired and playful designs.
properties.description: Wildfox is a women's lifestyle brand that captures the effortless energy of Southern California through vintage-inspired apparel. Founded in 2007, the brand is widely recognized for its iconic graphic tees, soft knits, and playful loungewear collections that prioritize comfort without sacrificing style. Targeting a broad demographic of women who embrace a carefree and bold aesthetic, the label remains a staple for those seeking a relaxed yet expressive wardrobe. The brand continues to focus on themes of nostalgia and whimsical design, maintaining a strong cult following through its distinct aesthetic.

properties.short_description: Color of Change is a national online racial justice organization that designs campaigns to end practices unfairly holding Black people back and champions solutions for equity.
properties.description: An organization dedicated to creating a more human and less hostile world for Black people in America. It designs and leads powerful, data-driven campaigns to end practices that hold Black communities back and to win solutions that drive meaningful progress. By mobilizing a large, active, and influential membership, the entity forces accountability from corporations and political leaders. It operates at the intersection of technology, advocacy, and social justice to build lasting systemic change.

properties.short_description: Lush is a cosmetics brand known for its fresh, handmade, vegetarian, and cruelty-free beauty products.
properties.description: Lush is an innovative cosmetics company renowned for its fresh, handmade beauty products and commitment to ethical business practices. Founded in 1995, the brand has grown into a global retailer known for its vibrant, unpackaged bath items and high-quality skincare that prioritizes animal welfare and environmental sustainability. By actively engaging in social activism and sourcing materials ethically, the brand maintains a unique position as both a mainstream commercial success and a persistent challenger to industry norms in waste and supply chain transparency.

properties.short_description: Beloved Shirts is a clothing brand known for its unique and playful apparel, including graphic t-shirts and swimsuits featuring fun designs like pizza and avocados.
properties.description: Known for its distinctive all-over print aesthetic, the brand creates apparel that functions as a vehicle for digital humor and visual expression. Founded in 2012, it has established a niche by offering high-definition graphic designs on everyday garments like t-shirts and swimwear. The brand primarily serves a digitally native, young audience that values unconventional style and social media-worthy looks. It occupies a unique, accessible space in the market, bridging the gap between novelty goods and mainstream contemporary casual wear.

properties.short_description: VICE is a global media brand known for original journalism and content covering diverse cultural, social, and political topics, including its Spanish-language platform VICE en Español.
properties.description: Originally founded as a punk magazine in Montreal, the brand has evolved into a massive, multi-platform media entity focused on investigative journalism and cultural reportage. It distinguishes itself by prioritizing authentic, first-hand storytelling and unconventional perspectives that often challenge mainstream narratives. Through a mix of video, text, and digital media, it serves a global audience that values transparency and exploration of the world's most complex sociopolitical issues. The brand holds a unique position as both an established media powerhouse and a voice for the countercultural zeitgeist.

properties.short_description: Thinx is a brand specializing in reusable period and bladder leak underwear designed to absorb flow and prevent leaks while keeping wearers fresh.
properties.description: Thinx is a trailblazing personal care brand that revolutionized the menstrual hygiene industry by introducing high-performance, washable, and reusable period underwear. Founded in 2014, the brand addresses the environmental and health concerns associated with traditional disposable products by offering sustainable, comfortable alternatives. It caters to a wide range of menstruators, promoting body positivity and menstrual equity through inclusive marketing. The company operates as a key player in the wellness space, focusing on providing reliable protection that aligns with modern, eco-conscious consumer values.

properties.short_description: CUUP is a lingerie brand specializing in stylish, supportive, and comfortable bras and underwear, offering a wide range of sizes and flattering designs.
properties.description: Established to disrupt the traditional lingerie market, this brand focuses on providing high-quality, supportive undergarments that cater to a wide spectrum of sizes. By combining technical precision with a minimalist design aesthetic, it appeals to modern consumers who value comfort as much as style. The company operates primarily through a direct-to-consumer model, emphasizing transparency and inclusivity. Its commitment to body positivity and functional elegance has positioned it as a key player in the contemporary intimates landscape.

properties.short_description: Daisie is a creative community app founded by Maisie Williams that connects users with industry experts in film, fashion, art, photography, and design for collaboration and feedback.
properties.description: Daisie is a community-driven digital platform designed to bridge the gap between aspiring creatives and industry professionals. By facilitating collaboration, mentorship, and feedback across fields like film, fashion, art, and design, it functions as a modern, accessible art school alternative. The brand focuses on democratizing access to professional growth, helping users build their portfolios and networks through meaningful connections. It serves as a hub for the next generation of creative talent looking to navigate their careers in a collaborative environment.

properties.short_description: VSCO is a community-driven photo and video editing app offering premium filters, editing tools, and a creative platform for photographers and creators.
properties.description: Established in 2011, this platform is a leading digital suite for mobile photographers and creators who seek professional-grade editing tools. It provides an intuitive interface filled with film-inspired presets and features that emphasize aesthetic expression over vanity metrics. By fostering a dedicated community of creators, the brand has become synonymous with the modern standard for mobile visual storytelling. It serves as an essential tool for those looking to elevate their content with a sophisticated, cohesive visual style.

properties.short_description: Betsey Johnson is a fashion brand known for its creative and vibrant women's clothing, handbags, and accessories.
properties.description: Established in 1964, this iconic American brand is renowned for its signature maximalist aesthetic that blends punk influence with high-energy whimsy. The brand offers a wide range of fashion-forward products including apparel, footwear, and accessories known for bold prints, sequins, and playful detailing. Targeted at expressive individuals who embrace color and individuality, the brand maintains a strong, loyal following. It occupies a unique space in the fashion market, balancing professional design heritage with an irreverent and fun-loving spirit.

properties.short_description: Girlboss is a community and media brand empowering ambitious women with career inspiration, insights, and resources for success on their own terms.
properties.description: Originally founded as a media company, this brand has evolved into a prominent voice for professional women seeking resources for success. It provides a blend of career insights, industry intelligence, and community-driven content designed to empower individuals to navigate their professional paths. By focusing on career growth, entrepreneurship, and workplace empowerment, the brand serves as both an informational resource and a supportive community. It maintains high cultural relevance by addressing contemporary issues surrounding work-life balance and the modern professional landscape.

entities.name: Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights

properties.short_description: The Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights is the nation's oldest, largest, and most diverse coalition advocating for civil and human rights policies.
properties.description: The Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights is a preeminent coalition of over 240 national organizations working to defend and advance the rights of every person in the United States. Founded in 1950, the organization coordinates national lobbying efforts and public policy advocacy on behalf of a broad range of civil rights issues. By convening diverse partners, it acts as a central force for legislative change and the protection of democratic ideals. Its work spans voting rights, police accountability, immigrant rights, and economic security, serving as an essential hub for the nation's civil rights infrastructure.

properties.short_description: Jeffrey Campbell is a footwear brand known for stylish boots and shoes, offering a variety of trendy designs for different occasions.
properties.description: Established in Los Angeles, this footwear brand has built a global reputation for its daring, trend-forward aesthetic and signature chunky silhouettes. The brand bridges the gap between high-fashion runway looks and accessible street wear, offering a vast array of boots, platforms, and heels for style-conscious individuals. With a focus on experimentation and creative expression, it has cultivated a devoted following among fashion-forward youth and influencers. Its products are widely recognized for their bold hardware, eclectic materials, and willingness to push the boundaries of conventional footwear design.

properties.short_description: Depop is a fashion marketplace app for buying and selling second-hand, vintage, and designer clothing and accessories.
properties.description: Established in 2011, this platform has evolved into a leading social marketplace where fashion lovers buy and sell unique, pre-loved items. It distinguishes itself by blending traditional e-commerce with social networking, allowing users to build a following and curate shops. The brand primarily serves a young, style-conscious audience driven by sustainable consumption habits and the pursuit of unique, individual pieces. Owned by Etsy, Inc., it continues to define the landscape of the circular economy by making secondhand fashion accessible and engaging for a global community.

properties.short_description: Starface is a skincare brand known for its star-shaped hydrocolloid pimple patches that absorb fluid and reduce redness, making acne care fun and expressive.
properties.description: Starface is a transformative skincare brand that reframes acne treatment as an act of self-expression rather than a clinical necessity. By creating signature star-shaped hydrocolloid patches, the company has built a cult following among Gen Z by making blemish care fun, visible, and celebratory. The brand emphasizes accessibility, vegan formulations, and a playful design ethos that challenges traditional beauty industry tropes. Through strategic retail partnerships and a heavy focus on social media engagement, the company continues to lead in the approachable, trend-driven acne care market.

properties.short_description: Cha Cha Matcha is a beverage company specializing in matcha drinks and matcha-related products, with locations primarily in New York.
properties.description: Cha Cha Matcha is a beverage and lifestyle brand that has popularized high-quality matcha by blending traditional Japanese tea culture with a vibrant, modern New York aesthetic. The company focuses on providing clean, sustained energy through its premium matcha offerings available in cafes and via home-brewing kits. Committed to sustainability, the brand emphasizes eco-friendly practices, including the elimination of single-use plastics. It serves a design-conscious audience seeking functional wellness products that fit seamlessly into their everyday rituals.

properties.short_description: Dolls Kill is a global online fashion brand and boutique known for edgy, alternative clothing and accessories for misfits and unique style seekers.
properties.description: An online retail brand that serves as a central hub for alternative fashion enthusiasts globally. Founded in 2011, it curates and produces apparel, footwear, and accessories that draw heavily from subcultures like goth, cyberpunk, and rave fashion. With a focus on provocative and non-conformist designs, the brand has cultivated a loyal community of consumers who prioritize bold, expressive individual identity. It operates primarily through its direct-to-consumer digital platform, maintaining high engagement via digital trends and community-driven marketing.

properties.short_description: Ben & Jerry's is a premium ice cream brand known for its creative flavors and commitment to social and environmental causes.
properties.description: Founded in 1978 in a renovated gas station in Burlington, Vermont, the brand has grown from a local ice cream shop into a globally recognized producer of super-premium ice cream. It is celebrated for its dense, mix-in-heavy flavor profiles like Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough and Cherry Garcia. Beyond its products, the company is distinguished by its deep-rooted commitment to social and environmental activism, often incorporating its values into its marketing and operations. Now owned by Unilever, it maintains its unique identity through a playful, values-driven approach to the frozen dessert category.

properties.short_description: ban.do is a lifestyle brand offering cheerful and colorful clothes, accessories, planners, and stationery designed to inspire joy and help you be your best self.
properties.description: An upbeat lifestyle brand founded in 2008 that focuses on bringing color and joy into everyday life through its product range. The company creates planners, stationery, home decor, and apparel aimed at encouraging self-care and positive mental health. By emphasizing the importance of putting oneself first, the brand has cultivated a loyal audience of individuals who seek to combine productivity with personal happiness. Its offerings are known for their vibrant, eclectic aesthetic and emphasis on creative expression.

properties.short_description: Serengetee is a travel-inspired clothing brand known for apparel made with unique fabrics sourced from over 25 countries, supporting global artisans.
properties.description: Serengetee is a travel-inspired apparel brand founded on the mission of supporting global artisans through fashion. By incorporating unique, handmade fabrics sourced from over 25 countries, the brand offers a tangible connection between the wearer and international cultures. Their product range focuses on casual essentials like t-shirts and hoodies that feature these distinct textile designs. The company maintains a strong social impact model, dedicating a portion of profits to the artists and organizations behind the fabrics.

properties.short_description: Herschel Supply Co. is a design-driven brand specializing in high-quality backpacks, bags, travel goods, and accessories with smart storage solutions and a focus on seamless travel.
properties.description: Founded in 2009 in Vancouver, the brand specializes in manufacturing functional, design-led backpacks, travel goods, and accessories. It is widely recognized for combining nostalgic heritage silhouettes with contemporary, clean aesthetics. Its products are geared towards students, professionals, and travelers who value utility and timeless style. The company operates primarily through direct-to-consumer and retail channels, maintaining a reputation for reliability in the everyday-carry market.

properties.short_description: Studs is a brand specializing in personalized ear piercing services and earrings, emphasizing unique self-expression through ear piercing and earring stacking.
properties.description: A pioneering retail and service brand that elevated the ear-piercing experience by combining professional, needle-based services with an extensive collection of curated jewelry. By focusing on the concept of the 'Earscape,' the brand empowers customers to express their individual style through curated combinations of piercings and earrings. It provides a safer and more aesthetic alternative to traditional mall-based piercing kiosks, positioning itself as a modern leader in the intersection of beauty services and jewelry retail.

properties.short_description: MeUndies is a brand specializing in comfortable, high-quality underwear, bras, and socks, offering a membership subscription for savings.
properties.description: MeUndies is a digital-native fashion brand that has revolutionized the essentials market by prioritizing extreme comfort and self-expression through its signature soft fabrics and bold, rotating print library. Founded on the principle that people should be able to express their personality even in their innermost layers, the brand utilizes a direct-to-consumer membership model to make high-quality underwear and loungewear more accessible and convenient. Its market position is defined by an inclusive, body-positive ethos, serving a diverse audience looking for reliable, stylish staples that hold up to everyday wear. Beyond its core product line, the brand maintains strong cultural relevance through high-profile pop culture collaborations and a community-centric approach to customer engagement.

properties.short_description: Warby Parker is a retailer of eyewear including prescription glasses, sunglasses, and contacts, known for its Buy a Pair, Give a Pair program.
properties.description: An American direct-to-consumer eyewear company that offers affordable, stylish prescription glasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses. Founded with a social mission, the brand operates under a buy-a-pair-give-a-pair model to distribute eyewear to people in need. It has grown from an online-only startup into an omnichannel retailer with numerous physical showrooms, providing a seamless customer experience for vision care and stylish optical products. The company is recognized for its disruptive retail approach and commitment to balancing profit with social responsibility.

properties.short_description: NOTO Botanics is a vegan, clean beauty brand offering multi-use, natural skincare and color cosmetics designed for all skin and hair types.
properties.description: Founded by beauty industry expert Gloria Noto, the brand provides a curated collection of genderless, multi-use skincare and color cosmetics. By focusing on high-quality botanical ingredients and minimalist formulations, it challenges traditional beauty norms to serve all skin types and tones. The brand emphasizes versatility and ease, encouraging users to celebrate their authentic selves through an uncomplicated and effective self-care routine.

properties.short_description: For Love & Lemons is a women's fashion brand known for vintage-inspired dresses, lingerie, and artisan-crafted apparel.
properties.description: For Love & Lemons is a prominent women's fashion brand celebrated for its distinctively romantic and vintage-inspired designs. Known for its signature use of intricate lace, custom floral prints, and dreamy silhouettes, the brand offers a wide range of apparel, including dresses, matching sets, and lingerie. It caters to a feminine, fashion-forward audience that seeks both style and an aspirational sense of escapism. Over the years, it has established a cult-like following through its strong digital presence and unique artistic aesthetic.

properties.short_description: Refinery29 is a global media platform delivering daily news, fashion, beauty, entertainment, wellness, and lifestyle content aimed at inspiring and empowering women.
properties.description: Refinery29 is a global digital media and entertainment company focused on providing news, lifestyle content, and creative storytelling for women. Established in 2005, the platform has grown into a significant voice for millennial and Gen Z audiences, covering a wide array of topics from fashion and beauty trends to health, sexual identity, and social activism. It maintains a distinct, vibrant visual identity and operates with a mission to keep women inspired and entertained through its editorial articles, video series, and newsletters. As part of the Vice Media Group, the brand balances a focus on cultural relevance with informative, community-driven content that addresses both contemporary interests and personal development.

properties.short_description: Los Angeles Apparel is a manufacturer, designer, and distributor of basics apparel including hoodies, t-shirts, and sweatshirts, based in South-Central Los Angeles.
properties.description: Based in South-Central Los Angeles, this company operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer and retailer of high-quality, everyday basics. It distinguishes itself through a strong commitment to domestic production, ethical labor practices, and the payment of living wages to its workforce. The brand is recognized for its wide array of garment-dyed hoodies, sweatshirts, and t-shirts that emphasize durability and timeless design. By manufacturing locally, the company maintains a transparent supply chain and fosters close ties to the local community.

properties.short_description: Reformation is a sustainable women's clothing brand known for eco-friendly dresses, tops, jeans, shoes, and accessories.
properties.description: A pioneering fashion brand that successfully integrates contemporary design with deep environmental commitment. It offers a range of women's apparel and accessories characterized by feminine, vintage-influenced silhouettes and an effortless aesthetic. By prioritizing sustainable practices such as carbon neutrality and the use of recycled materials, it appeals to modern, eco-conscious consumers. Its business model focuses on direct-to-consumer sales, emphasizing high standards of production and transparency in the fashion industry.

properties.short_description: MyIntent Project is a brand offering customizable bracelets engraved with personal intention words to inspire mindfulness and positivity.
properties.description: MyIntent Project is a movement-based brand that creates customizable engraved jewelry as a tool for mindfulness and positive personal reflection. Founded on the belief that everyday items can serve as meaningful reminders, the company empowers individuals to choose a specific word that represents their personal intention. By encouraging users to share their stories and even craft their own pieces with Maker Kits, the brand fosters a community centered on positivity and intentional living. Its offerings are popular as both personal daily wear and thoughtful gifts for loved ones and larger groups.

properties.short_description: AllSaints is a British fashion retailer known for its iconic leather jackets, clothing, footwear, and accessories for men and women.
properties.description: Established in 1994, this British fashion house has become globally recognized for its signature leather jackets and dark, urban-inspired tailoring. The brand occupies a premium space in the market, balancing high-quality construction with an edgy, non-conformist personality that resonates with creative individuals. Its offerings span menswear, womenswear, and footwear, all unified by a consistent commitment to authentic design and effortless style. With a strong physical and digital presence, the label serves an audience that values self-expression and modern, timeless wardrobe staples.

properties.short_description: Mikkeller is a Danish craft brewery founded in Copenhagen in 2006, known for its innovative beers and global presence.
properties.description: Established in Copenhagen in 2006, this innovative brewery is globally recognized for its constant experimentation and wide variety of beer styles. By collaborating with renowned brewers and focusing on unique, high-quality ingredients, it has transformed from a micro-project into a symbol of modern craft culture. The brand appeals to adventurous drinkers who value artistic packaging and complex flavor profiles. Through its bars, festivals, and international distribution, it continues to shape the global craft beer movement.

properties.short_description: Founders Brewing Co. is an American craft beer company known for its diverse range of craft beers including popular varieties like Kentucky Breakfast Stout and Centennial IPA.
properties.description: Founders Brewing Co. is a prominent American craft brewery founded in 1997 in Grand Rapids, Michigan, celebrated for its complex, flavorful ales and barrel-aged innovations. The brand has evolved into a major player in the national craft beer scene, maintaining a reputation for quality while staying rooted in its Michigan identity. Known for staples like All Day IPA and the highly regarded KBS, the brewery focuses on brewing the beers they want to drink, catering to both casual social drinkers and dedicated craft enthusiasts. Their business model centers on widespread national distribution coupled with a vibrant local taproom experience.

properties.short_description: Dogfish Head Brewery is a craft brewery known for its off-centered ales and unique beer styles, including popular IPAs and pale ales.
properties.description: Dogfish Head Brewery is a celebrated craft pioneer founded in 1995, famous for its off-centered approach to brewing and distilling. Based in coastal Delaware, the brand offers a diverse range of unique ales, spirits, and canned cocktails designed for those who seek unconventional flavor experiences. It maintains a strong commitment to community enrichment through its Beer & Benevolence program while managing a multi-faceted hospitality footprint. As part of the Boston Beer Company, the brand continues to lead the craft sector through persistent innovation and cultural collaboration.

properties.short_description: Trillium Brewing Company is a New England farmhouse-style brewery known for craft beers and multiple taproom locations in Massachusetts.
properties.description: Founded in 2013, Trillium Brewing Company is a premier New England farmhouse-style brewery that has gained a dedicated following for its commitment to high-quality, artisanal beer production. Operating multiple taprooms across Massachusetts, the brand focuses on crafting a diverse range of beers, from hop-forward IPAs to complex farmhouse ales. It prioritizes community engagement, offering unique event spaces and a welcoming atmosphere that resonates with craft beer enthusiasts. By combining technical excellence with a community-first philosophy, the brand has established itself as a cornerstone of the regional craft beer scene.

properties.short_description: Lone Star Brewing Company, founded in 1884, is known for Lone Star Beer, 'The National Beer of Texas,' popular for its deep Texas roots and cultural significance.
properties.description: Established in 1884 in San Antonio, the brand has grown into a legendary symbol of Texas history. It is positioned as a mass-market, budget-friendly lager that serves as a cornerstone of social gatherings across the state. Through decades of association with local culture, music, and food, it remains deeply rooted in the everyday lives of its target audience.

properties.short_description: Odell Brewing is a 100% employee-owned independent craft brewery known for its innovative beers and multiple taproom locations in Fort Collins, Colorado.
properties.description: Odell Brewing is a premier, employee-owned independent craft brewery established in 1989 in Fort Collins, Colorado. The brand is celebrated for its commitment to innovation in brewing techniques and its deep-seated connection to the local community. Through its flagship brewery and multiple taproom locations, it provides high-quality, hand-crafted beers while prioritizing environmental sustainability and philanthropic engagement. Odell remains a pillar of the craft beer industry, balancing long-standing tradition with a forward-thinking approach to production and ownership.

properties.short_description: Maine Beer Company is a brewery based in Freeport, Maine, known for crafting high-quality beers including IPAs and stouts.
properties.description: Maine Beer Company is a mission-driven brewery founded in 2009 by brothers David and Daniel Kleban in Freeport, Maine. Built on the principle of "Doing what’s right," the company prioritizes environmental stewardship and ethical business practices alongside a commitment to brewing high-quality, consistent IPAs and ales. By refusing to compromise on quality, they maintain a strong reputation in the national craft beer market while donating a portion of sales to environmental causes. Their approach blends industrial precision with a deep-rooted dedication to the local community and the planet.

properties.short_description: Stella Artois is a premium pilsner beer brand known for its distinctive flavor and iconic packaging.
properties.description: Originating from a centuries-old brewing tradition in Leuven, Belgium, this brand has evolved into a global symbol of premium lager. Known for its iconic chalice and commitment to quality, it positions itself as a sophisticated choice for those who appreciate the finer details of social entertaining. The brand maintains a strong market presence through its focus on European heritage, refined aesthetics, and its association with high-quality dining experiences.

properties.short_description: Left Hand Brewing Company is an independent craft brewery in Longmont, Colorado, known for innovative beers like Milk Stout Nitro and Belgian White Nitro.
properties.description: Left Hand Brewing Company is an employee-owned craft brewery based in Longmont, Colorado, established in 1993. The company is widely recognized for its dedication to community-driven values and its pioneering role in developing nitro-packaging technology for bottles and cans. Their diverse portfolio includes a range of stouts, ales, and IPAs, emphasizing high-quality ingredients and craft techniques. Through extensive distribution, the brand brings its flavor-forward, hand-crafted products to beer enthusiasts across the United States and internationally.

properties.short_description: Lagunitas Brewing Company is a craft brewery known for a wide range of beers from hazy IPAs to non-alcoholic options, with a popular taproom in Petaluma, California.
properties.description: Founded in 1993 on a kitchen stove in Northern California, this craft brewery has grown into a globally recognized name known for its hop-forward IPAs. The brand maintains a counter-cultural and inclusive identity, welcoming diverse individuals and emphasizing community connection through its taprooms and events. While widely distributed, it keeps its authentic, playful voice and continues to innovate with new product categories like non-alcoholic hoppy sparkling beverages. It is currently a subsidiary of the Heineken company.

properties.short_description: Cisco Brewers is a brewery and distillery in Nantucket, Massachusetts, offering beer, wine, spirits, and related merchandise.
properties.description: Cisco Brewers is a multi-faceted beverage producer based on Nantucket island, encompassing a brewery, winery, and distillery. Known for capturing the laid-back spirit of island life, the company creates a wide range of craft beers, wines, and spirits on its historic Bartlett Farm Road location. With a strong cult following and a presence across multiple locations in Massachusetts, the brand prioritizes authentic craftsmanship. It maintains a distinct identity that bridges the gap between premium craft beverage enthusiasts and those seeking a quintessential coastal experience.

properties.short_description: Stone Brewing Company is a craft brewery known for bold, flavorful beers, especially its popular IPAs and diverse beer varieties.
properties.description: Founded in 1996 in San Marcos, California, this brewery helped define the West Coast style IPA and remains a giant in the craft beer industry. Known for a rebellious ethos, it produces a diverse portfolio of bold, flavorful beers while prioritizing ingredient quality and community connection. The brand operates production facilities on both US coasts and offers unique hospitality experiences through its bistro and taproom locations. It maintains an uncompromising commitment to freshness and craft integrity as a cornerstone of its business.

properties.short_description: New Belgium Brewing Company is a craft brewery based in Fort Collins, Colorado, known for its beers, food trucks, and community events.
properties.description: Founded in 1991, this brewery has grown from a home-brewing project into a national leader in the craft beer industry while maintaining its commitment to human-centric business practices. As a certified B Corp, the company integrates environmental and social impact into every aspect of its operations, from brewing to community outreach. Known for its Belgian-inspired ales and popular hop-forward IPAs, the brand caters to adult consumers who appreciate both quality craft products and ethical corporate governance. Its presence extends across the United States, anchored by brewing facilities and a strong connection to cycling and outdoor exploration.

properties.short_description: Sierra Nevada Brewing Co. is a family-owned craft brewery known for its flagship beers and pioneering role in American craft brewing.
properties.description: Sierra Nevada Brewing Co. is a prominent, family-owned American craft brewery founded in 1980 by Ken Grossman. It is best known for its iconic Pale Ale, which played a foundational role in the growth of the American craft beer industry. The brand emphasizes the use of high-quality ingredients, particularly hops, and maintains a strong commitment to environmental sustainability. With facilities on both coasts, the company remains 100% family-owned, focusing on innovation and maintaining high standards in its diverse lineup of beers.

properties.short_description: Rogue Ales & Spirits is an Oregon-based brewery and distillery crafting world-class ales, lagers, spirits, and canned cocktails since 1988.
properties.description: Established in 1988 in Newport, Oregon, this independent producer creates a wide variety of craft ales, lagers, spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages. Known for its innovative approach, the brand emphasizes the use of unique, often locally sourced ingredients. It holds a distinct position as a pillar of the Pacific Northwest craft scene, appealing to enthusiasts who value independence and craftsmanship. The company continues to experiment with new flavor profiles while maintaining a rugged, coastal-inspired identity.

properties.short_description: Dunkin' is a popular American brand known for its coffee, espresso, donuts, and a variety of breakfast and snack items, offering rewards and mobile ordering.
properties.description: An iconic quick-service chain providing a consistent array of coffee, espresso, and baked goods to millions of daily customers. Founded in 1950, it has evolved into a staple of the American morning routine, leveraging a vast franchise network and mobile technology to emphasize convenience and speed. The brand occupies a mass-market position, appealing to commuters and workers who value affordability and reliability. Its identity is built on the promise of fueling an active, busy lifestyle with accessible, high-energy refreshments.

properties.short_description: Starbucks is a global coffee company known for its handcrafted beverages, coffee products, and café experience.
properties.description: Starbucks is a leading multinational coffeehouse chain known for its signature roasts, handcrafted beverages, and focus on creating a welcoming community atmosphere. Founded in Seattle’s Pike Place Market in 1971, the brand has grown into a global institution that prioritizes human connection alongside high-quality coffee. Its business model relies on a widespread retail footprint, offering a consistent customer experience for millions of daily visitors worldwide. The company remains focused on ethical sourcing and professional barista training to maintain its market position as the standard-bearer for accessible, premium café experiences.

properties.short_description: Curious Elixirs is a brand of award-winning booze-free craft cocktails made with organic ingredients and adaptogens to help you unwind.
properties.description: Curious Elixirs produces award-winning, non-alcoholic craft cocktails infused with adaptogens to help consumers unwind. Founded in 2015, the brand focuses on layered, complex flavor profiles inspired by classic cocktails, using organic ingredients to provide a premium social experience without alcohol. It targets health-conscious adults who value mindfulness and wellness, operating primarily through a direct-to-consumer subscription model.

properties.short_description: Coca-Cola is a global beverage brand known for its iconic soft drinks, committed to sustainability and local production.
properties.description: Coca-Cola is the world's most ubiquitous beverage brand, synonymous with the cola soft drink category since its invention in the late 19th century. Built on a foundation of universal optimism and refreshment, the brand maintains a massive global footprint through highly localized production and distribution. It consistently occupies a central role in social moments, from everyday meals to major global sporting events and holidays. The brand is defined by its iconic red aesthetic, proprietary bottle silhouette, and a commitment to evolving its sustainability practices while maintaining a deeply established heritage.

properties.short_description: LaCroix Sparkling Water is an American brand of zero-calorie, zero-sweetener flavored sparkling water known for its variety of natural fruit flavors.
properties.description: LaCroix is a prominent American sparkling water brand celebrated for its variety of natural, essence-flavored options that contain no calories, sweeteners, or artificial additives. Established in the early 1980s, the brand gained massive popularity for its vibrant, distinctive packaging and health-conscious profile. It has since become a cult favorite, appealing to a wide range of consumers looking for a refreshing, guilt-free alternative to sugary sodas. By focusing on simple, clean ingredients, the brand has firmly positioned itself as a lifestyle staple for modern, wellness-oriented households.

properties.short_description: STōK Cold Brew is a brand of cold brew coffee known for its bold, low and slow brewed coffee products designed to energize and inspire.
properties.description: STōK Cold Brew is a prominent coffee brand known for its commitment to a slow, methodical brewing process that produces a smooth, low-acid, and high-caffeine coffee. Designed for busy consumers who require convenient energy without compromising on flavor, the brand has established itself as a staple in the refrigerated coffee category. It leverages bold branding and active lifestyle partnerships, such as its role with Wrexham AFC, to reach a broad audience of active, performance-oriented coffee drinkers. STōK emphasizes consistency and a high-quality, ready-to-drink experience that integrates seamlessly into daily routines.

properties.short_description: Guayakí is an organic beverage company specializing in yerba mate products, offering a variety of brewed yerba mate blends in still and sparkling formats.
properties.description: Guayakí is a pioneer in the yerba mate industry, committed to regenerative agriculture and sustainable business practices. The brand offers a wide range of organic brewed yerba mate products in both still and sparkling formats, designed to provide a natural, clean energy boost. Their mission focuses on empowering indigenous communities and protecting biodiversity in South American rainforests. By combining traditional cultural roots with modern consumer needs, they appeal to environmentally conscious individuals seeking an alternative to conventional energy drinks and coffee.

properties.short_description: Keurig is a company that manufactures single-serve coffee makers and K-Cup pods, offering programmable coffee machines for home and commercial use.
properties.description: Keurig is a leading provider of single-serve brewing systems designed to simplify the preparation of hot beverages for both home and commercial use. Established in 1998, the brand has revolutionized the coffee industry by allowing users to enjoy fresh-brewed coffee, tea, and other drinks at the touch of a button. Its product ecosystem includes a wide range of brewers and an extensive variety of beverage pods, positioning itself as an essential convenience for busy professionals and families. The brand maintains a mass-market appeal through its wide distribution and emphasis on consistency and variety.

properties.short_description: Hint is a brand offering pure flavored water with natural fruit flavors like watermelon, coconut, peach, and raspberry, available in various products including sparkling options.
properties.description: Founded in 2005, this brand provides refreshing water infused with natural fruit flavors without any sugar, diet sweeteners, or preservatives.
